title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 51 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 51)

content.overview: Section 51 preserves rights that a person would have had to enforce in India or otherwise avail of an award if Chapter I of Part II had not been enacted.
content.glance: Section 51 preserves rights that a person would have had to enforce in India or otherwise avail of an award if Chapter I of Part II had not been enacted.
content.study:
Section 51 — Saving

Section 51 preserves rights that a person would have had to enforce in India or otherwise avail of an award if Chapter I of Part II had not been enacted.

Apply the provision within Chapter II of Part II and identify the precise Convention framework, statutory condition and enforcement consequence. Do not treat enforcement as a merits appeal.
